text:
maya: heads-up — pulled an audit NDJSON for tenant `globex-prod` and a lot of records have `actor_id` as an empty string "" instead of null. Export was Console -> Audit exports (v1).

maya: sample line:
```
{"ts":"2025-04-11T09:12:03Z","event":"routing.rule.modify","tenant":"globex-prod","actor_id":"","actor_hint":null,"details":{}}
```

sam: empty string is a schema smell. v1 allowed loose normalization; v2 added explicit `actor_unresolved`. Did you use v1 exporter?

maya: yeah modal said "Audit NDJSON (v1)". Most empty-actor rows are routing/infra changes.

khoa: likely two paths: enrichment failed and normalizer turned missing -> "" OR old consumers wrote empty id and our sanitizer passed it through. I'll check resolver and sanitizer logs for that job id.

liz: compliance: emitting empty-string PII is unacceptable. We need deterministic contracts: either no `actor_id` key + `actor_unresolved:true` OR `actor_id:null`. Also customers sometimes need correlation so propose a tenant-scoped non-reversible tag.

sam: agreed. Proposed roadmap:
- Immediate: map empty-string -> null + add `actor_unresolved:true` in export post-processor (backfill for v1)
- Medium: promote v2 exporter in console (deprecate v1) — v2 includes `actor_unresolved`, `actor_class`, and `actor_tag` (tenant-scoped HMAC)
- Long: entitle `actor_tag` to enterprise exports only, add manifest file for bundles.

khoa: HMAC details: use tenant_key_id + HMAC_SHA256(tenant_key, canonical_actor_id). Compute in export service without storing raw ids. Key rotation: include key_id in manifest so tenants can map old tags if they hold past keys.

maya: for `actor_class` can we emit simple enum: human|service|system|unknown? That helps downstream filtering and keeps `actor_hint` separate.

liz: yes. For service/system we still redact PII but `actor_class:service` informs auditors. Legal wants `actor_tag` to be non-reversible and tenant-scoped. I'll loop in @matt-legal.

sam: telemetry: track per-export metrics: `audit_export.unresolved_count`, `audit_export.unresolved_ratio`, `audit_export.v1_mapped_count`, and `audit_export.actor_tag_size_delta_bytes`. Alert if unresolved_ratio > 0.05 for enterprise exports.

maya: console UX: show deprecation banner for v1 and default to v2. Add a small note: "If identity resolution fails, some rows will include actor_unresolved:true. Use v2 for stable flags and tenant-scoped actor_tag for correlation."

khoa: implement plan:
1) sanitizer patch: empty->null + attach actor_unresolved for in-flight v1 exports (cheap, can ship today)
2) HMAC helper and actor_class derivation in exporter (PR)
3) generate manifest JSON alongside NDJSON bundle with: job_id, schema_version, record_count, unresolved_count, actor_tag_algo, tenant_key_id

sam: manifest is great for downstream validators. Make sure manifest does NOT include secrets (only key_id). We'll also expose a small preview in Console UI that shows unresolved ratio before download.

liz: compliance checklist: 
- actor_tag non-reversible verified by cryptography team
- tenant-key management audited
- opt-in checkbox for including actor_tag (enterprise entitlement)
I'll draft sign-off PR and test cases required.

maya: QA tests: mapping empty->null, v2 schema validations, actor_tag stability across keys (with key_id tracking), manifest correctness, console preview shows unresolved ratio.

sam: ops/alerts: add identity-resolver 5xx monitor and export-unresolved alert. Add Grafana panel for per-tenant unresolved ratio over time.

export-bot: job 988201 archived (v1). Re-run possible after v2 rollout.

maya: ok i'll open a product ticket with rollout timeline: ship sanitizer today, canary v2 in staging for 7 days, measure size delta, then flip default for console exports and deprecate v1 after 30 days. attach this thread.

khoa: i'll start the sanitizer PR + HMAC helper and post link here.

sam: i'll add telemetry counters and draft alert playbook.

liz: looping in legal and security for final sign-off.

maya: thanks team :thumbsup:
